## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I listed the exact tests, commands, and hardware paths I ran.
- [ ] I updated documentation, configuration examples, and release notes where needed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, generated runners, model weights, media, databases, or private research notes.
- [ ] I recorded any upstream reuse or clean-room research in `NOTICE` and the exploration ledger.
- [ ] I reviewed model/adapter terms and updated `docs/model-licenses.md` when a default or recommendation changed.
- [ ] I considered persisted IDs, parameters, migrations, rollback, privacy, and security boundaries.

## Validation evidence

List commands, environment, GPU/VRAM when relevant, and any check not run.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe user-visible migration, rollback, or recovery behavior. Write "None"
when the change has no persisted or operational impact.
